en: Wally
Uncle, please! I want to challenge the Gym. I know Ralts and I can do it!
Wally's Uncle
Now, Wally, you've only just got here. Don't you think you're pushing yourself?
Wally
But we've been training! We can beat anyone!
{player}! You came at just the right time. Will you battle me? If I win, my uncle will see how strong I am!
Wally
{player}... Please, will you battle me? I have to show my uncle!
Battle Wally?
Wally
Thank you! Ralts, here we go!
Wally
I... I lost. You really are strong, {player}.
Uncle... I'll go back to Verdanturf with you. I'm not ready for the Gym yet.
{player}, thank you. Battling you showed me how much further I have to go.
Wally's Uncle
Don't be down, Wally. You battled well, and you'll only get stronger. Come visit us in Verdanturf, {player}!
Wally
Oh... Then my uncle will never believe I'm strong enough.
Scott
I watched the whole thing. You didn't hold back against him, did you? That's how it should be!
That boy will grow strong too, I can tell. Well, see you around!
Wally's Uncle
Wally's been so full of energy since he caught his Ralts. It's wonderful, but I do worry about him.
Could you battle Wally for me? He won't listen to me, but losing to you might teach him patience.
Boy
Have you seen the television in the Pokémon Center? The shows change all the time, so check it often!
I've been watching all the shows. There's always something new on!
